name: @funcd-dev/example-kv-claim
description: A funcd KV example: a function that races for a claim on a key with context.kv's conditional writes (putIfAbsent, compareAndSet, delIf) and expiring keys. Authored in TypeScript against @funcd-dev/shim; vite build (@funcd-dev/vite-plugin) bundles it to a self-contained claim.mjs; the I/O contract lives in claim.contract.yaml.
